verdict.rationale: This axis fairly applies to Cline: it has its own provider account and runs headless in CI and scheduled pipelines, so issuing scoped API keys for agents is a plausible capability. The evidence covers only bring-your-own provider keys (cline-docs-27, cline-docs-42) and sign-in with Cline credits (cline-docs-43). Auto Approve controls which actions the agent may take (cline-docs-38), but it does not issue credentials. Nothing shows Cline issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent.
